hamstring.notes: Intimate leg-cut: burst stack stripped to a whisper of sparks so the low slice + bleed drips read, not an explosion.

overpower.notes: Surgical counter-stab: flat ring and flipbook removed, one vertical pierce-ring snaps perpendicular to the thrust line.

sunder_armor.notes: Armor shear is metal-on-metal: no fireball, no shockwave — cranked sparks plus flying plate debris carry the rip.

slam.notes: The 1.5s charge now pays off seismically — the ground splits caster-to-target under the blow, breaking the vertical+groundSlam twin with Execute.

execute.notes: THE kill moment keeps no motif but becomes the kit's only full-stack cataclysm impact — everything on, so nothing else in the kit compares.

thunder_clap.notes: Weapon-into-dirt now ejects five sequential ground eruptions ringing the warrior — the seismic clap finally earns its name.

cleave.notes: Slash ribbons whirl around the caster at release — the blade-flurry read splits it from Thunder Clap's ground shock for good.

defensive_stance.notes: Translucent plates snap into a guarding forward arc as the stance settles — block fantasy made literal, unique among the kit's buffs.

frostbolt.notes: Cold shatters instead of exploding: fire-flash flipbook and smoke removed, crystalline shard debris added — the impact frame finally splits from fireball's blaze.

fire_blast.notes: The instant punch is a clean concussive pop — flipbook flash + heavy sparks only, no lingering dressing, the snap-hit foil to scorch's smolder.

scorch.notes: Intimate char, no fireworks: rings and flipbook stripped to a few ignition sparks and a rising smolder — the target scorches rather than detonates.

arcane_missiles.notes: Orbitals ARE the missiles — three orbs circle then slam one-two-three matching the 3 ticks; stock flipbook/ring stripped so the sequenced slams carry the whole read.

frost_nova.notes: The finisher freeze earns a set-piece: ice pillars erupt around the ring while icy chunk debris flies — no fire flash, splitting it cleanly from arcane_explosion.

arcane_explosion.notes: Spammable pulse stays motif-free by design; impact sculpted to an immaculate ring+sparks arcane wave — no flipbook, no dirt, pure energy.

conjure_water.notes: Fantasy made literal: arcing streams rain into the condensing orb between the palms — the flattest buff in the kit finally shows what it conjures.

ice_barrier.notes: The L20 absorb IS a shield: translucent plates snap into a guarding arc at cast, splitting it from frost_armor's quiet drifting glints.

sinister_strike.notes: Spam builder goes lean — slash flash only, no ground ring, a short spit of sparks; the lone horizontal saber arc stays the show.

backstab.notes: The quiet kill: no flash, no ring, six sparks — silence from the blind spot IS the signature, opposite pole to eviscerate.

gouge.notes: Dirty eye-rake drops the burst flash and keeps only the low ground ripple, which now reads as the daze settling under the stars.

eviscerate.notes: The kit's one full-violence hit: debris torn loose plus a 36-spark spray on the twin cross-slash — maximal where backstab is silent; no motif, the stance-crouch finisher identity already carries it.

kidney_shot.notes: The stun made visible: chains snap up and bind through the stun, ground ring ceded to them, vertical shock ring for the blunt drop.

adrenaline_rush.notes: L20 capstone announces the frenzy — slash ribbons whirl around the rogue at release while the heartbeat rings still carry the duration.

judgement.notes: The verdict IS the radiant cross-flash: generic flipbook burst cut so the cross owns the skybeam's landing.

consecration.notes: Five sequential holy pillars erupt around the hallowed 8yd ring; center flipbook cut so the story stays on the ground.

hammer_of_justice.notes: Golden chains snap up and bind through the stun — no ring, no flipbook, sparse sparks: a sentence, not an explosion.

divine_protection.notes: Translucent plates snap into a guarding arc at cast then hand off to the orbiting facets — the bubble gets an arrival moment.

holy_light.notes: The answered prayer lands as arcing light-streams raining onto the ally, splitting the big heal from Flash of Light's humble orb.

serpent_sting.notes: Vines re-read as the spectral serpent coiling up the target; impact stripped to a wet fang-prick flicker so the rising venom fumes carry the dot.

mongoose_bite.notes: Intimate reflex-counter: no fireworks, just the vRing as the jaws' snap-plane and a short spark spit — pure speed, zero spectacle.

wing_clip.notes: Humble low leg-hack: flash and rings removed, kept debris so the cut scuffs dirt at ankle height; the bleed drips do the talking.

concussive_shot.notes: Blunt daze reads blunt: no flash, zero sparks — just the shock ring, kicked debris and a dusty smoke thud, nothing like aimed_shot's crack.

arcane_shot.notes: Clean arcane pop: full flash and rings kept but no dirt or smoke — magic detonation, not a physical hit; splits it from both physical bolts.

aimed_shot.notes: The kit's lone max-stack payoff after the 2.5s draw — every layer plus near-max sparks, smokeless because it's a piercing crack, not an explosion (also splits it from raptor_strike's stock stack).

smite.notes: Radiant cross-flash seals the skybeam; holy light kicks up no dirt or smoke — clean judgement, splits it from every earthy burst.

shadow_word_pain.notes: A whispered curse, not an explosion: dark shapes burst away from the victim and the stock fireworks are stripped — the fleeing swarm IS the hit.

power_word_shield.notes: The iconic bubble earns its apply moment: translucent plates snap into a guarding arc before settling into the orbiting facet shell.

heal.notes: The flagship 2.5s prayer's payoff: arcing streams of light rain onto the ally, so the long cast lands visibly bigger than the lesser heals.

mind_flay.notes: Mental drain has no physical fireworks — ticks are stripped to a few sparks so the writhing drain-worm carries the read, not a stock burst x3.

flash_heal.notes: Urgency as exposure: white-hot core on the release splits it from lesser_heal's warm humble flare — the last same-palette pair reading identical.

healing_wave.notes: Fountain streams arc down onto the ally with the sky-light release — the shaman water-heal fantasy made literal; the kit's only heal now carries its own signature.

flame_shock.notes: A searing brand, not a blast: shockwave rings stripped, smolder-smoke and a few embers only, so the hit reads as branding flesh and feeds straight into the rising-ember DoT.

frost_shock.notes: Flash-freeze crack: fiery flipbook and spark fireworks removed, ice-shard debris added — a brittle shatter silhouette fully split from earth_shock's fissure slam.

stormstrike.notes: Storm-blade flurry: slash ribbons whirl around the shaman as both charged weapons release, with cranked electric sparks and slam debris — the L40 payoff earns full fireworks.

shadow_bolt.notes: Void collapse: space sucks inward right before the hit and no shockwave rings escape — the bolt swallows, it doesn't explode; splits it from every other class's filler bolt.

demon_skin.notes: Chitin plates snap into a guarding arc on cast so the armor buff reads ARMOR at a glance, not another generic shell raise.

immolate.notes: Ignition, not concussion — flame flipbook, ember spray, and a smoke curl with zero shockwave rings; the target catches fire rather than getting punched.

corruption.notes: Rot blooms wet and quiet — no fireworks, just a smoky seep; the identity stays in the festering ichor orb windup and venom fall drips.

curse_of_agony.notes: The curse seats with a burst of dark shapes fleeing the victim — dread made visible — while the stock explosion is stripped so only the ramping wave-drips carry it.

drain_life.notes: Intimate siphon — each drain tick lands as a bare fleck so the sinuous toward-caster flow stays the whole picture.

searing_pain.notes: White-hot needle: no explosion at all, just a grinding spray of sparks off the point of contact — the anti-shadow_bolt silhouette finished.

shadowburn.notes: The kit's one cataclysm — every impact layer on under the shadowflame skybeam, earned by being the only ability that gets it.

healing_touch.notes: Fountain: arcing life-streams rain onto the ally as the canopy light releases - the flagship heal's set-piece, splitting it from the quieter HoTs.

thorns.notes: Vines coil up and wrap the blessed target as the bramble armor takes - thorns finally LOOK like growth, not a generic spark shell.

barkskin.notes: Barrier plates snap into a guarding arc as the skin hardens to bark - the panic button reads as a block, distinct from Thorns' living coils.

demoralizing_roar.notes: Swarm: courage visibly flees - dark shapes scatter off the demoralized enemies, splitting the big roar from Growl's plain taunt wave.

starfire.notes: Crescents: twin moon-blades sweep through the target at the stellar impact - the finisher's payoff finally matches its constellation-ritual windup.

claw.notes: Light spam builder de-fireworked: no shockwave ring, just the triple gash and a few sparks.

rake.notes: Intimate bleed opener: no flipbook, no ring, 8 sparks - a quiet tearing cut that lets the lingering wound speak.

maul.notes: Blunt paw slam: dirt debris and smoke with sparks cut to 10 - heavy and earthen, the opposite silhouette of Claw's quick gashes.

ferocious_bite.notes: Finisher crunch: vertical ring and debris on the jaw snap - the kit's heaviest melee impact, towering over Rake's near-silent bleed.
